name: vyce-renew
description: Automatically renew free servers on vyce.cloud every 24 hours

scripts.setup:actions: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.mkdirSync('.github/workflows',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('deploy/renew.workflow.yml','.github/workflows/renew.yml');console.log('已创建 .github/workflows/renew.yml，提交并推送后即可启用定时任务。')"
